testSolution.sourceLimitation: Sections 12.15 and 11.7.5 are stubs redirecting to an external TransArmor document not present in this workspace.

independentFindings.finding: SEG116-R-009 source conflict corroborated by low AI confidence
independentFindings.description: The AI catalog's own entry for 'the Totals with Proprietary Data Load Request transaction includes TransArmor Load Data Segment (Data Segment No. 116)' carries only 34% confidence, the lowest of any Segment 116 requirement, consistent with the independently found Section 11.4.1.2 vs. Element 85/Section 12.17 conflict.
independentFindings.impact: Confirms the conflict is a genuine source artifact and that the AI pipeline itself flagged it as uncertain.

independentFindings.description: AI requirements BR-402-5 and REL-ENT-ELEM-86-ENT-SEG-116 (80% confidence) suggest Sequence Number (Element 86) may be part of Segment 116, but this derives from Element 86's generic 'included on all transaction types' statement rather than a Segment 116-specific table.
independentFindings.impact: Useful lead for whoever obtains the external TransArmor document; not sufficient to certify as a Segment 116 field on its own.
